component.name: Zerkalo
component.summary: Typst editor with live preview, LSP completions, and git sync

description.p: Zerkalo is a GTK4 editor for Typst documents with a focus on academic and contemplative writing. It embeds the Typst compiler directly — no external binary required — and renders a live preview as you type.
Editor features:

ul.li: Multi-file tabs with modified indicator and inline compile-error dots
Syntax highlighting, find and replace, auto-pair brackets
LSP completions via bundled tinymist — type # for a popup
Citation autocomplete — type @ for fuzzy BibTeX key search
Spell check with suggestions, Ignore All, and language selector
Word count, reading time, word-count goal, and session delta in the status bar
Command palette (Ctrl+K) — fuzzy search over commands and headings
Breadcrumb bar showing your heading path as the cursor moves

description.p: Document workflow:

ul.li: New from Template — dialog generates a complete Typst preamble
Import from LaTeX, DOCX, or PDF via pandoc
Export to PDF, HTML, DOCX, ODT, or LaTeX
Citation style switcher with GOST 7.32 support
Git sync — commit and push to all remotes in one click

description.p: Sidebar:

ul.li: File tree, citation panel, plan scratchpad, and section notes
Symbol insert panel for Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew, and Sanskrit

description.p: Simple Mode toggle in status bar: hides Typst front-matter above the document body. Style dropdown moved to the toolbar. Open-tabs button removed.
Fix: preview pane scroll works immediately after first compile, without needing to resize the pane.
Fix DOCX/LaTeX import: all pandoc preamble blocks (#set, #show, #let conf) now stripped correctly so imported files compile cleanly.
Fix LaTeX and DOCX import inside flatpak (pandoc now routed via flatpak-spawn --host). Error panel shows "Line N" for each error.
Export for Web: converts the active Typst file to an HTML fragment via pandoc; footnotes become hover tooltips that respond to light/dark mode.
Delete button (trash icon) beside every file in the open dropdown — confirmation dialog, closes tab if open, removes from list.

Changelog window renders release notes with proper formatting. Lock buttons on Author/Affiliation in template dialog. Flatpak now sources locally — no push needed for test builds. RC versioning scheme introduced. Setup wizard widened.
Right-click any editor tab to close it or delete the file (with confirmation). Fix: app no longer re-creates old project folder on launch. Author/affiliation lock compile fix.
Start maximized. Setup wizard is resizable again. tinymist and pandoc shown as bundled (always verified); only git and hunspell show install instructions.
Update What's New window to reflect 0.12.29 features: single-file workspace, status bar layout changes, page gaps in preview, session restore, accurate LCS snapshot diffs, and popout maximize button.

Status bar: autocorrect and GOST toggles moved left; Style dropdown and Draft/Final toggle moved to status bar right (Draft is bold). Preview: 20px gray page gaps for clear page boundaries. Session restore: opens last file on startup. Snapshot diff: proper LCS diff instead of positional comparison. Setup wizard: fixed size, flatpak tool detection fixed. Popout preview: maximize button added.

Color-coded diff views: removed lines red, added lines green, git hunk headers blue. Fix history panel click not working (same connect_activate bug as snapshots). Document Statistics now uses proper adw::ActionRow layout instead of monospace text.
Fix Browse Snapshots: clicking a snapshot now updates the diff view and enables the Restore button (was using connect_activate which only fires on Enter, not single click).

Fix preview pane size resetting on open (pane position now ignored during initial GTK layout). Fix git sync using wrong directory (now uses git rev-parse to find repo root from active file). Remove leftover Open Project Folder and Recent Projects menu items.

Single-file workspace: removed project mode entirely. The active tab is always the compilation root — no root chip, no "Set as Compilation Root", no project config root_file. Removes ProjectModel, is_project_mode flag, New Project wizard, and Project Settings dialog.

Fix crash when clicking headings in multi-file project outline (jump deferred to idle to avoid reentrancy). Fix compile ignoring changes in project mode (is_project_mode flag now correctly detects explicit project vs. single-file). Fix Ctrl+S resetting project root. Fix "Project Settings…" chip row doing nothing (popover now dismissed correctly before showing dialog). Add "Clear root file" to the chip popover so users can exit project mode.

Root chip now shows "Project Settings…": clicking the compilation root chip opens a popover with candidate root files and a Project Settings row at the bottom. Outline filenames moved to hover tooltip so section names are fully readable.

Fix live preview not updating while typing in a multi-file project: the debounced change handler was overriding the compilation root with the active tab on every keystroke. Also bumps flatpak runtime to GNOME Platform 50.

Fix crash when clicking files in a multi-file project (double-borrow panic in tab-switch handler). Fix compile button resetting the project compilation root on every tab switch. Fix tinymist, pandoc, git history, and pdftotext inside the flatpak sandbox.

Fix startup git warning in the flatpak (now checks via flatpak-spawn --host). Welcome window updated with current 0.12 features. GOST Type B font bundled in Kopilka, Rubric, and Zerkalo flatpaks so it is available to Typst documents and the UI font toggle inside the sandbox.

Template build system: templates are now real .typ files editable without touching Rust; user templates auto-load from ~/.config/zerkalo/templates/. New Chapter button creates a file and inserts #include in main.typ. Project Settings dialog for per-project root and bibliography. Cross-file outline shows headings from all project files.

Multi-file project system: New Project wizard with four templates (Blank, Essay, Journal/Thesis, Theological Journal), compilation root indicator (★) in the file tree, status bar root chip with quick-switch popover, collapsible directory rows, #include and #import insert helpers, and session-restore fixes for newly created projects.
Flatpak fixes: git sync now works via flatpak-spawn --host; Typst package cache (~/.cache/typst) is now accessible inside the sandbox.
Strip debug symbols from flatpak binaries to reduce package size.
Git Remotes dialog now includes a Primary Remote section for viewing and editing the origin URL.
